source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
This unit moves freely during each **[Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)**, **[Advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)** or **[Fall Back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)** it makes:

- It can pass over models (except **TITANIC** models) and **terrain features**.
- While doing so, it may come within **[Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)** of an enemy model, but may not end the move there.
- It passes every **[Desperate Escape test](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape)** automatically.
